# Kurio NFT Marketplace

> Kurio is a Portuguese-language marketplace for discovering and collecting curated digital NFTs.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://nft-marketplace-kappa-livid.vercel.app/)
- [Marketplace](https://nft-marketplace-kappa-livid.vercel.app/mercado)
- [Learn](https://nft-marketplace-kappa-livid.vercel.app/learn)

## Important notes

- Prices are displayed in ETH.
- NFT availability and prices are illustrative marketplace data.
- Users can browse NFTs, save favorites, add items to a cart, and complete a simulated checkout.
